findings.finding: The root rumfus.ini is a packaged update payload; wufilelist.ini is the launcher patch manifest. Calling the root file itself the launcher manifest is unsupported.
The launcher has a generic raw-byte size/CRC verification flow applicable to root rumfus.ini. Its retained ReadFile event does not establish parsing or decryption of that file.
The root file and GameGuard/RumFUS.ini must remain distinct evidence items. No common content, copying relationship, endpoint grammar or decoder has been established.
No supported game server override or offline switch is identified by this follow-up.

evidence.meaning: Start of patch manifest processing routine.
Supplies FILE_COUNT with GENERAL to integer INI helper.
Supplies PATHNAME to manifest string accessor; stores each package-relative filename.
Supplies FILESIZE; integer value stored at per-file record offset 0x08.
Supplies FILECRC; integer value stored at per-file record offset 0x10.
Supplies FILEHEADCRC; integer value stored at per-file record offset 0x14.
Calls 0x425050 to obtain existing local file size, then compares against stored FILESIZE at 0x41d162.
Calls 0x424ad0 with offset 0 and length -1 for full-file CRC on extensions outside the special .igx/.nsz/.gmf/.ogg/.wav set.
Compares computed full-file CRC with the manifest FILECRC.
Special media/archive path calls the same checksum helper with limit 0x400; compares FILEHEADCRC.

File checksum helper uses CreateFileA at 0x424b00, optional GetFileSize at 0x424b28, SetFilePointer at 0x424b3d, ReadFile via imported pointer 0x4380e4, 4096-byte chunks and CRC accumulator 0x424990; no content-field parsing in this routine.
CRC accumulator uses complemented initial/final value and reflected byte-table recurrence.
All 256 DWORD table values exactly match standard reflected CRC32 polynomial 0xedb88320; file offset 0x3cab0.
File size helper opens the path, calls GetFileSize, closes handle and returns size; no content parsing.

decoder_status.reason: The traced launcher path reads generic package files for CRC checking. There is no evidenced format-specific parser here to translate into a decoder.
